final_judgment_basis: Independent reading of repository review requirements, stage design, new tests and modified existing real-payment assertions, relevant production callers, all workflows, Cargo gating, and the full funded scheduler.
Exact C2 source/tree/synthetic parents independently tied to all 10 terminal PR runs and all 23 terminal jobs, attempt 1, with complete original logs and all 44 original byte hashes checked.
Complete raw-log scan plus direct examination of Rust target/name/result sequences, native completion and strict Clippy/build termination; all 196 harness results are complete and unfiltered.

Platform-specific new library names execute in all relevant default and funded library jobs; all seven new CLI names execute in both funded interface jobs; all four existing funded active-flow tests execute in both library jobs.
The independently frozen non-Rust review was read in full after all evidence arrived, and both Markdown and machine-report identities were recomputed and verified before this final judgment.
The historical C1 formatter rejection is retained without granting it C2 execution credit; exact C2 independently completed the entire required matrix.

historical_candidate_rejection.candidate_formatter_failure_closed_by: C2-only four-file ten-hunk formatter correction plus complete fresh 10-run/23-job native success

limitations: This is an independent retained-evidence/source-binding review, with native execution credit exclusively from exact-candidate GitHub CI, not a local native workload rerun.
The final judgment concerns this exact C2 runtime tree and stage scope. It does not substitute for the separate non-author implementation review or verification of a later changed tree.
Windows conditional race/fuzz steps remain skipped; applicable Ubuntu steps ran. Platform-specific tests receive credit only on their actual native OS; there is no macOS execution evidence.

Complete CLI planning performs four full replays including both opens; the method on already opened archives performs two. Per-verifier authorization caches start empty. No replay-time or planner resource optimization is established.
Success confirms a bounded read-only append plan, not an atomic snapshot under arbitrary hostile mutation, persistent incremental backup, delta import or snapshot state import.
The real-payment tests use temporary local NO-FUNDS fixtures. CI and agent reviews do not establish external crypto/security certification or real-funds safety.
The growth workload is 100000 local worker blocks, 99998 empty and two paid, followed by reopen/continuation to 100001; it is not 100000 payments or four-node consensus at that height.
Fixed 32+1 resource evidence is one segment, not archive/planner cost, a 64-entry cache boundary, maximum commitments, full archive capacity, or 2048-range resource coverage.

Resource values are per-process-generation OS lifetime resident/working-set observations, not phase peaks, private heap, all-process totals, allocation caps or comparable cross-platform performance claims; coordinator/supervisor roles are excluded.

No physical power-loss, disk-full, true OOM, Windows directory persistence, long-term multi-machine operation, pruning/migration, validator signing-state restoration or finality guarantee is established.
Artifact member integrity and native build/source association are not independent reproducible-build or publisher-signature proof. Downloaded native binaries were not executed locally.
